deployment.simulator_boundary: pp_rank identifies the failed stage; current SGLSim makes the containing DP replica unavailable during replacement

victim_selection: v11_observed_real_backups_only; victims with recompute-only acks dropped
schedule_basis: v11 measured per-rank queue-depth idle windows plus outage-containment margins; dp2 fails twice in disjoint idle windows [319,478] and [1000,1399]; dp1/dp0 have no clean window with backed-up victims

design_notes.why_no_dp1_failure: dp1 queue depth never hits 0 between t=82 and t=749 (07dd fan-out stream); late idle windows [1399,1468]/[1612,1688] only contain 0bc p2 requests whose algorithm-2 acks are recompute-only (no backup to reuse)
design_notes.why_no_dp0_failure: dp0 has no depth-0 window >= 40s anywhere in the v11 timeline
design_notes.retry_safety: every victim backup target is either never failed (dp0/dp1) or fully recovered before the victim retry checkpoint (dp3 recovers ~408s, first dp3-target retry ~1090s)
design_notes.execution_safety: no planned arrivals on the failed rank during any bounded outage: dp2 has none in [319,478] and [1000,1399]; dp3 has none in [350,~440]
design_notes.pp_stage_coverage: events use pp_rank 0/2/1 so the three events touch three distinct pipeline stages
